summary: The ConnectionFailed feature is an ASP.NET web page which informs users of a failed connection event. It displays distinct headers and navigation maps for English and French locales and presents a localized error message to the user.
purpose: To notify users that a connection to the web application has failed, provide relevant resources and navigation links, and ensure the experience is localized for English or French users.

entities.name: ConnectionFailed
entities.description: Handles UI and logic for representing connection failure notification.

fields.name: HeaderEN
fields.description: Displays English header and navigation map.

fields.name: HeaderFR
fields.description: Displays French header and navigation map.

fields.name: uxErrorMessage
fields.description: Displays an error message for connection failure, localized.

actors.name: User
actors.role: Web application visitor who encounters a connection failure.

workflows.name: ConnectionFailed Page Display
steps: User attempts to access a resource in the web application.
System determines a failed connection scenario.
Locale is determined from QueryString['Locale'], defaulting to English if not specified.
HeaderEN is shown if locale is English or not set.
HeaderFR is shown if locale is French.
Localized error message (uxErrorMessage) is displayed with failure details.
User is provided with navigation links: Contact Us, Glossary, Feedback, Homepage.

business_rules: HeaderEN is visible only when locale is 'en-US' or missing.
HeaderFR is visible only when locale is 'fr-CA'.
Navigation maps and links are shown corresponding to detected locale.
validations: Locale must be a valid culture string ('en-US', 'fr-CA').
conditions: If QueryString['Locale'] == 'en-US' or is empty, display HeaderEN.
system_behavior: Page_Load event controls visibility of English/French header panels based on locale.
InitializeCulture method sets thread UI and culture accordingly.
dependencies: Resources file (for localized error message and page title).
External navigation links (contact, glossary, feedback, homepage).
exceptions: If locale is invalid or missing, defaults to English.
If connection failure occurs, user is routed to ConnectionFailed page.
content_gaps: No details on how or when connection failure is specifically detected.
No information about error logging or user support escalation.
No functional description for uxErrorMessage content except resource reference.
No details about accessibility or mobile compatibility.
